notes:
ACNA parish (Diocese of Western Anglicans, Arizona Anglican Deanery), formerly Joy Faith Anglican Church. Anglican congregations are in scope for this project.

Address resolved 2026-09-10: the church's own homepage and about page both give 9200 N Oracle Rd, Oro Valley, AZ 85704, and say the congregation meets Sundays at 4:30pm in the Chapel Hall of Canyon Del Oro Bible Church at that address. This replaces the seed record's 'address not confirmed' placeholder and supersedes the older Mystic Rhythms Ballroom listing (they left the dance studio in late 2020). It is still borrowed space, so re-check if the record goes stale. Coordinates cleared so tools/geocode.py runs on the confirmed address.

Clergy, from the about page: Fr. Blake Plympton is the rector - he was extended the call in October 2023/2024 and started in December 2024 (the about page says December 2024; a secondary source said the offer was made in October 2023, so the exact call date is uncertain but the December 2024 start is from the church's own page). Fr. Pete Forbes planted the church in 2013 and stepped down in 2024; he is not listed here because he is no longer the preaching pastor. No other clergy or lay preachers are named on the site.

Sermon media: the seed record's kingscrosstucson.org/sermons-and-audio URL now 404s and was replaced with /sermons. Sermons are YouTube embeds; the videos embedded on that page (e.g. 'The Instructed Eucharist 2026', 'Instructed Eucharist Short') resolve to channel UCOspUBv1mZMZ2tVUFo6axYA / @kingscrossanglicanchurch1553, which confirms that channel is the parish's own. The site itself does not print a channel link and the sermons page does not name the preacher of each sermon, so preacher attribution will have to come from the video titles/descriptions. There is also a 'King's Cross Tucson' podcast listed on Audible that may be theirs; not verified, so not recorded.
